notes.benchmark_chain: Applicable Rate → 'Eurocurrency Rate Loans' → Adjusted Eurocurrency Rate → Eurocurrency Rate → Screen Rate → ICE LIBOR, Reuters LIBOR01/LIBOR02. 'Eurocurrency' here means LIBOR per the vocabulary rule. Benchmark replacement machinery (§1.09, §3.04, 'Term SOFR', 'Daily Simple SOFR', 'Benchmark Replacement' definitions) is conditional and ignored.
notes.libor_floor: Not a field. Adjusted Eurocurrency Rate carries a 0.75% floor on the Initial Term Loans and a 0.00% floor on the Revolving Credit Facility.
notes.base_rate_margin: Not a field. 2.25% for both tranches — exactly 100 bps under the Eurocurrency margin, consistent with the convention.
notes.commitment_fee_grid: NOT a margin grid; has_margin_grid stays false. 'Applicable Commitment Fee' is 0.50% from the Closing Date until the first Compliance Certificate, then a three-level grid on Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio: >3.75x → 0.500%; 3.25x–3.75x → 0.375%; <3.25x → 0.250%, with a Pricing Level 1 default-to-worst on late financials. Candidate for a v2 has_commitment_fee_grid field; not added.
excluded_from_facilities: Letter of Credit Sublimit ($10,000,000) — 'part of, and not in addition to, the Revolving Credit Facility'. No record.
§2.01(c) post-closing Term Loans under other Tranches / §2.14 Incremental Facilities / §2.15 New Incremental Debt / §2.18 Specified Refinancing Debt — options, not commitments at signing. No record.
No swingline facility in this agreement.
notes.multicurrency: Revolving Credit Loans may be denominated in Alternative Currencies (subject to agent and lender approval), but Article I defines the Eurocurrency Rate only for Dollar borrowings; no alternative-currency benchmark limb exists. Primary benchmark is unambiguously LIBOR.
notes.maturity: Both tranches use the ordinary 'earliest of' / 'earlier of' construction (stated date, termination of commitments, acceleration). The proviso re-pointing 'Maturity Date' for loan-modification, incremental, or specified-refinancing tranches does not affect the two closing-date tranches. No springing maturity proviso.
notes.schedules: Schedule 2.01 (lender-by-lender commitments) is listed in the TOC but not attached to the filed exhibit, so the lender-column cross-check cannot be performed. The defined terms ('Initial Term Commitment', 'Revolving Credit Commitments') state the aggregates and govern regardless.
notes.covenant_beneficiary: Standard cov-lite structure: the Financial Covenant is for the benefit of the Revolving Credit Lenders. §8.02 gives the Required Revolving Lenders sole control over remedies for a 'Financial Covenant Event of Default'; Term Lenders may not accelerate or exercise remedies on a Financial Covenant breach until the Cure Right (§8.03) has run. Recorded as a financial covenant of this agreement per the rule.
notes.covenant_first_test: Tested 'commencing with the second full fiscal quarter ending after the Closing Date' (2021-06-25). §2.07(a) references 'the fiscal quarter ending on December 31, 2021', indicating a calendar fiscal year, which puts the first test period at the quarter ending 2021-12-31. Level is flat at 6.50x for the life of the agreement — step_down_schedule [] is confirmed flat, not unknown.
notes.covenant_lc_exclusion: Cash Collateralized Letters of Credit and undrawn Letters of Credit are excluded from the utilization numerator for the 35.0% trigger. Noted per rule; does not change the threshold.
notes.covenant_test_timing: §7.08 second sentence: when the trigger is met, compliance is tested on the date Financial Statements for the Reference Period are delivered (or required to be delivered), not before. Timing mechanic only; frequency remains quarterly.
